_comment: App key -> HikaShop language key, for strings whose English differs but whose meaning is
the same. tools/build-locales.mjs matches identical English on its own; this covers the
rest, so the app says what the merchant's own backend says, in each of the 60 languages.
Every pair here was checked against en-GB.com_hikashop.ini, and the generator skips a key
that does not exist rather than shipping a hole.
